class.name: PlayFabLobbyJoinConfig
class.brief_description: Configuration for joining a PlayFab lobby.
class.description: Passed to [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_lobby_async] and [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_arranged_lobby_async]. [member member_properties] applies to both. [member max_member_count], [member access_policy], [member owner_migration_policy], and [member restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner] initialize the lobby that an arranged join creates and are read only by [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_arranged_lobby_async]; an ordinary [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_lobby_async] neither applies nor validates them. Presence works differently here than on [PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig]. The three scalar native fields are mandatory, so an unset or cleared value resolves to [code]8[/code], [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PRIVATE], or [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_AUTOMATIC]. The invitation restriction defaults to [code]false[/code]. Assigning a value marks its field present even when that value is zero or [code]false[/code]; [code]has_*[/code] reports assignment, not whether the compiled SDK supports the requested value. [member restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner] is a compile-time capability. Enforcing [code]true[/code] requires an addon DLL compiled against the April 2026 GDK (edition [code]260400[/code]) or later; merely installing a newer SDK does not upgrade an already-built DLL. On an older build, an arranged join requesting [code]true[/code] fails with [code]E_NOTIMPL[/code] and code [code]unsupported_on_gdk_edition[/code] before the native join call. Omitted, cleared, or explicitly [code]false[/code] requests remain fully supported and preserve unrestricted invitations. This flag controls PlayFab Lobby invitations. It does not restrict Xbox multiplayer activity invitations or Xbox platform joins. Only the first successful joiner's values initialize a newly created arranged lobby. Values supplied by later joiners do not update an existing lobby. All participants in an arrangement should supply identical settings; the addon forwards each local call and does not reconcile conflicts or reconfigure the lobby. Invalid values are rejected rather than clamped: the returned [PlayFabResult] fails with code [code]invalid_arranged_lobby_config[/code].

method.name: has_max_member_count
method.description: Returns whether [member max_member_count] was explicitly assigned. When [code]false[/code], an arranged join sends [code]8[/code].

method.name: clear_max_member_count
method.description: Resets [member max_member_count] to the default [code]8[/code] and marks it unassigned.

method.name: has_access_policy
method.description: Returns whether [member access_policy] was explicitly assigned. When [code]false[/code], an arranged join sends [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PRIVATE].

method.name: clear_access_policy
method.description: Resets [member access_policy] to [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PRIVATE] and marks it unassigned.

method.name: has_owner_migration_policy
method.description: Returns whether [member owner_migration_policy] was explicitly assigned. When [code]false[/code], an arranged join sends [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_AUTOMATIC].

method.name: clear_owner_migration_policy
method.description: Resets [member owner_migration_policy] to [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_AUTOMATIC] and marks it unassigned.

method.name: has_restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner
method.description: Returns whether [member restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner] was explicitly assigned, including an explicit [code]false[/code]. This reports assignment, not compiled GDK support.

method.name: clear_restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner
method.description: Resets [member restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner] to [code]false[/code] and marks it unassigned.

members.member: Initial string properties for the joining member.

Capacity of the lobby created by an arranged join. Must be between [code]2[/code] and [code]128[/code] inclusive; values outside that range are rejected. Set this to the game mode's capacity at join time rather than shrinking the lobby afterwards, which reopens a join race.

Access policy for the lobby created by an arranged join. Accepts [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PUBLIC], [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_FRIENDS] or [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PRIVATE].

Owner migration policy for the lobby created by an arranged join. Accepts [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_AUTOMATIC], [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_MANUAL] or [constant PlayFabLobbyConfig.OWNER_MIGRATION_NONE]. The native server-owned policy is not a valid client-arranged value and is not exposed.

Whether only the owner may send PlayFab Lobby invitations for a newly created arranged lobby. An explicit [code]true[/code] requires an addon compiled against GDK edition [code]260400[/code] or later; older builds fail the arranged join with [code]unsupported_on_gdk_edition[/code]. Omitted, cleared, and explicit [code]false[/code] remain supported on every edition. Later joiners do not reconfigure this value. This does not control Xbox activity invitations.
